trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the trailing edges of both lobes; right lobe distal edge exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep along the trailing edges of both fluke lobes extending from the medial region toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white rings and solid white spots (scars) are distributed across the dark dorsal surface of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle linear disruptions visible on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin and faint horizontal scratches on the mid-section of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant V-shaped notch located on the posterior margin of the dorsal fin; dense white calcified clusters (barnacles) present on the lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The calcified growth on the terminal tip of the left fluke lobe forms a distinct high-contrast geometric profile.
